chunks.arabic_text: رِجَالُ الْكَشِّيِّ: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ الْبُرَاثِيُّ وَعُثْمَانُ بْنُ حَامِدٍ الْكَشِّيَّانِ، عَنِ ابْنِ يَزْدَادَ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمَزْخَرَفِ، عَنْ أَبِي سُلَيْمَانَ الْحَمَّارِ قَالَ

translations.en: Rijal al-Kashshi: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Burathi and Uthman ibn Hamid al-Kashshi, from Ibn Yazdad, from Ibn al-Husayn, from Ibn al-Muzkhraf, from Abi Sulayman al-Hammar who said:

chunks.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ يَقُولُ لِأَبِي الْجَارُودِ بِمِنًى فِي فُسْطَاطِهِ رَافِعًا صَوْتَهُ: يَا أَبَا الْجَارُودِ كَانَ وَ اللَّهِ أَبِي إِمَامَ أَهْلِ الْأَرْضِ حَيْثُ مَاتَ لَا يَجْهَلُهُ إِلَّا ضَالٌّ، ثُمَّ رَأَيْتُهُ فِي الْعَامِ الْمَقْبِلِ قَالَ لَهُ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، قَالَ: فَلَقِيتُ أَبَا الْجَارُودِ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ بِالْكُوفَةِ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ: أَلَيْسَ قَدْ سَمِعْتَ مَا قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ مَرَّتَيْنِ؟ قَالَ: إِنَّمَا يَعْنِي أَبَاهُ عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ

translations.en: I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying to Abi al-Jarud in Mina, in his tent, with a raised voice: 'O Abi al-Jarud, by Allah, my father was the Imam of the people of the earth when he died; no one is ignorant of him except the misguided one.' Then I saw him the following year saying the same thing to him. He said: 'So I met Abi al-Jarud after that in Kufa and said to him: Did you not hear what Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said twice?' He said: 'He means by it his father, Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him).'

en.summary: Recorded in Rijal al-Kashshi, this hadith highlights the public affirmation of Imam al-Sadiq’s (peace be upon him) recognition of his father, Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him), as the 'Imam of the Earth,' emphasizing the continuity of Imamate within the Ahl al-Bayt. The repetition of the declaration in consecutive years underscores its significance, while Abi al-Jarud’s clarification resolves any ambiguity regarding the specific identity of the Imam, reinforcing the Shia doctrine of explicit designation (Nass).
en.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about his father Ali ibn Abi Talib in Mina?

key_terms.إِمَامَ أَهْلِ الْأَرْضِ: Imam of the people of the earth
